If you've explored the x402 protocol, you've noticed it exclusively supports USDC—not USDT. The reason is entirely technical: USDT doesn't implement the smart contract functions that x402 requires.
x402 payments on EVM chains rely on ERC-3009, which enables gasless, signature-based transfers. USDT's contract only implements standard ERC-20 functions—no transferWithAuthorization, no permit.
